newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Pharm issues shrs to fund purchase.
newsitem.headline: China Pharm issues shrs to fund purchase.

text.p: China Pharmaceutical Enterprise and Investment Corp Ltd said on Thursday it would issue 250.52 million new shares at HK$1.18 each to settle its purchase of a 72.99 percent stake in Hebei Zhongkang Pharmaceutical Co Ltd.

The Vitamin C maker said it would buy the stake in Heibei Zhongkang from Hebei Pharmaceutical Group Co Ltd for HK$295.61 million, raising its stake in Heibei Zhongkang to 99 percent from 26.01 percent.
Hebei Pharmaceutical Group is a wholly owned unit of the Vitamin C maker's controlling shareholder Shijiazhuang Pharmaceutical Group Co Ltd (SPG).
On completion of the deal, SPG's stake in the company will be increased to 69.86 percent from 57.27 percent, it said.
SPG is a Chinese state-owned enterprise engaging in the manufacture and sale of a variety of pharmaceuticals. SPG is under the supervision of the municipal government of Shijiazhuang City.
Hebei Zhongkang is a Sino-foreign joint venture in Shijiazhuang City in China's Hebei province.
